methods.label: Express the choices in a common form
methods.explanation:
The given decimal can be written as
\[
0.000000375=\frac{375}{10^9}=3.75\times10^{-7}.
\]
Thus choice \(\text{A}\) is equivalent. Choice \(\text{B}\) is also equivalent because \(3\frac34=3.75\), and choice \(\text{C}\) equals \(375/10^9\). For choice \(\text{E}\), multiplying numerator and denominator by 125 gives
\[
\frac{3}{8000000}=\frac{375}{1000000000},
\]
again the given number.

But choice \(\text{D}\) equals
\[
\frac38\times10^{-7}
=0.375\times10^{-7}
=3.75\times10^{-8},
\]
which is one tenth of the given number. Therefore the non-equivalent expression is \(\boxed{\frac38\times10^{-7}}\), choice \(\text{D}\).
